description: Extract text from scanned documents, receipts, screenshots, or scanned PDFs (max 10 MB, up to 3 PDF pages) via sharp, Ghostscript (-dSAFER) and Tesseract OCR. $0.004 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

lang.description: installed Tesseract language: eng (default) or osd

maxPages.description: max scanned PDF pages to OCR: 1-3 (default 2)

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

url.description: public http(s) URL of a PNG/JPEG/WebP/TIFF/GIF image or PDF

name: image_ocr
title: Image ocr
